frozen_before: Task 2 and any paid prompt; Task 1's successor of v1
authority: Plan 12.14 (sha256 hex:c2b80ad598d833da16b162d388aee234595f61d2aecc0b20f9f7dbb6d1af0bbc, D1-D7 approved 2026-11-23), sections Design choices, Evaluation and releases; sampling approved 2026-11-24 ("Approve sampling")

inputs.binding: every result names the sha256 of each input file and the git commit it ran at; a changed input invalidates earlier results

split_custody.development: Task 1: three real-index repetitions from paired captured channel inputs; selects the baseline or one utility candidate before any fresh qualification; may be inspected
split_custody.fresh: opened once, in Task 4, after CP1 froze the candidate; no replacement or tuning against it
split_custody.replays: seed held-out, M1 held-out, fresh, fresh2: each reported separately, never used for selection

packing_candidates.baseline: M1 greedy fill in fused order (delivered M2a)
packing_candidates.density: RRF score * (1 + marginal_terms / max(1, task_terms)) / max(1, candidate_tokens)
packing_candidates.coverage: RRF score * (1 + marginal_terms / max(1, task_terms)), then greedy fit
packing_candidates.fixed: RRF_K 60, WEIGHTS, CHANNEL_K 100, QUOTA and stable ties, M2a ambiguity authority; ranked output and recall at five unchanged; required files untouched; 25% signatures, remainder bodies; ties by fused ordinal, path, range, id; cost is the candidate's own serialized signature/excerpt/framing; marginal terms recomputed after each selection within a disclosure phase
packing_candidates.terms: lexical_terms(task) including the stop-word fallback; task_terms is its count

ships_only_if: evidence in context >= baseline in every development repetition, every replay set and the fresh set
strictly higher evidence in context on development and on fresh
zero stale, denied or wrong-scope evidence
recall at five equal to baseline

budget.T: floor(1,000,000 * input_target_usd / effective_input_price); effective price x 1.25 when a cache write is possible; zero price gives T = C
budget.chosen: min(C, max(V + min(1024, C - V), T)); optional_room = chosen - V
budget.entry: D3 only: anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 named via Role.EASY, input_target_usd 0.008192; other entries omit the field and keep the legacy min(floor(0.25 * usable_input), 16384)
budget.cp1_requires: per budget case R, T, C, allocation, pack bytes and digest; all four paid budget cases change substantive F/U pack bytes: >= two ordinary-fit allocation changes and two R values in (16384, C]; otherwise stop CP1

arms.N: actual engine-absent assemble_workspace_context_for_prompt(root, task=task), default 16 KiB bytes/order/truncation/diagnostics, the existing non-indexed Chat builder, no map
arms.B: delivered M2a packing, fusion and legacy budget, indexed map; an evaluator control
arms.U: the selected utility with B's budget, builder and map; U = B if the baseline is retained, and identical per-case prompts then share one recorded attempt and receipts under arm aliases
arms.F: U plus the qualified budget and overflow outline through the actual production builder, fit and binding
arms.verification: N checked against the fallback; F byte-for-byte against production builders at the tested head (Task 2); B and U are evaluator controls

arm_order.rule: each category's four cases, in case-id order, take these orders once
arm_order.record: cache warmth, order and timing per attempt

caps.rule: CP1 proves budget cases fit C + map + framing; a failed preflight stops before paid prompts; no cap increase after results

cohorts.forced_refusals: cases.json paid_q.cases[].forced_refusal (predeclared from sizes alone); reported separately; excluded from superiority and comparable-cost wins

adoption_and_cost_gates: utility passes its packing gates; recall at five unchanged

budgets: zero silent required omissions; required coverage >= U on deterministic budget and qualification sets; ordinary-fit uncached-repriced input cost <= U with one strict saving; all four budget cases change substantive pack bytes
paid F loses no B/U-success case, has success count >= N, and has zero safety or unsupported-material-claim failures

fully loaded uncached-repriced cost per success for every arm beside actual charges, denominators and coverage; comparable-cohort F costs <= B and <= U; zero-success ratios are unavailable; missing comparable evidence holds cost acceptance
one stochastic sample establishes no population superiority

Q.reservation: 3 physical attempts reserved before each logical request; the run stops when a reservation cannot be made inside 96, so retries may prevent completing intended requests

R.cases: four development cases, one configured top-12 reranker; output must permute the supplied ids exactly

expected_attempts.unintended_calls: none: no host retry, fallback, classifier, extraction, maintenance, repair or replacement; any is a breach recorded and stops the run

cache_observations: Q records reported cache usage and charges, prefix and request digests and order; cold and warm reported without attributing order discounts to policy; no production hit-rate or causal cache-savings claim

producer_contract_463.status: drafted by Claude; Codex agreement sought at CP1; no savings reader is built
producer_contract_463.record: reports/plan12-memory-m2b/paid-attempts.json, schema plan12-memory-m2b.paid-attempts.v1, owned by this plan
row: usage (input, output, reasoning nested, cached read, cache write)
producer_contract_463.rules: ADR-012/034/035: actual charges distinct from uncached repricing; overhead counted once; unknowns and negative savings retained; late, discarded, failed and unknown receipts kept; #463 may read this record later and owns any report integration

successor_of.change: adds the Task 1 freezes (frozen_in_task_1) and corrects the attempt topology; nothing in v1's cases, arms, orders, caps, cohorts or gates changes

selected_candidate.evidence: reports/plan12-memory-m2b/calibration.json (run 1 at git:4f2a991, sha256 hex:cbbf61c50400f737b78996d4e4bed26dc56ffb3d8ac7d13b76ed8ccc96a20307): every policy 16/35 evidence in every repetition; density fails the poison and 16,000 gates, coverage the irrelevant and 16,000 gates; no strict improvement
selected_candidate.consequence: U is an alias of B: identical per-case prompts share one recorded attempt; the utility code ships unused (default baseline)

tariff.cached_input: repriced at the ordinary input price
tariff.reasoning: nested in output, priced as output
tariff.label: ADR-034 estimate; actual charges recorded separately

scoring.selector: m2b_score.select: the delivered final answer less the host's search-limit notice (optimus.agent.index_turn.LIMIT_NOTICE); its digest is the script's

intended_composition.registry: src/optimus_model_policy/defaults.yaml plus models.anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.context_budget.input_target_usd = "0.008192" (staged in Task 2 as defaults.yaml itself, not an override)
intended_composition.approval: the operator approves this effective hash (D5's fresh hash approval) before Q; on gate failure the field is removed and the pre-change hash proven
deltas_from_shipping_production: index tools withdrawn: optimus.agent.runner.MAX_INDEX_ROUNDS = 0, so an indexed Chat turn is one zero-tool request carrying the runner's own limit observation
output cap 2,048 bound through RoutePolicy (production binds the implementer reserve, 32,768)

arm_configuration.B: memory turn, pack budget forced to the legacy policy host-side (same snapshot, binder and Gateway)
arm_configuration.F: memory turn, the route's own budget from the staged composition

task1_freezes.production_equivalence: Task 2: F's recorded request equals an unpatched runner's final-round request on the same turn, and B's pack digest equals calibration's BU pack_sha256 for the same case

attempt_topology.correction: a bound model request makes at most MAX_ROUTE_ATTEMPTS = 2 physical attempts (src/optimus_model_policy/binding.py:225); manifest.json's 3 is the legacy unbound loop (upstream_client.py:39) and is superseded here
attempt_topology.reservation: before each logical request: attempts_used + 2 <= 96 and settled USD + 0.04608 x (unknown attempts + 2) <= 6.00
attempt_topology.sent_requests: 30 of 36 rows (12 N, 7 B, 11 F); predeclared refusals send nothing: B on QB3, QB4, QO1, QO2, QO4; F on QO4 (and on QO1, QO2 until Task 3's outline)
attempt_topology.worst_case: 60 physical attempts, USD 2.76 at the caps

task1_freezes.answers_custody: answers are written only to a separate sink outside the repository (optimus-handoff/p1214-q-*), archived and hashed; paid-attempts.json keeps each answer's digest
task1_freezes.prefix_identity: src/optimus/agent/prompts.py is unchanged from git:7abbaa2; budget and outline disclosure go only inside the dynamic pack (Task 3 tests prefix digests)
task1_freezes.fit_note: calibration's full_input omits the runner's limit observation (about 130 bytes); the largest complete F input is QB4's, far under 65,536
